data.name: Arliene
data.gender_notes: Arliene is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arliene is a name derived from the Greek word 'arle' meaning 'dawn' and the Latin word 'lux' meaning 'light'. This name symbolizes the eternal light that comes with a new beginning or resurrection. The name Arliene carries the meaning “Eternal light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arliene usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Arliene belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eternal light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arliene total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: ארלין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ארלין הוא שם שמשמעותו אל רחמה לאהבה נאמנת, מורכב מהמילים אל ורחמה ומשמעותו לאהוב באהבה נאמנת וקבועה. השם ארלין קשור לאהבה ולנאמנות.

in_greek.name: Αρλιέν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αρλιέν σημαίνει αγάπη πιστή και ισχυρή. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος συνδέεται με την αγάπη και την πίστη, και αποτελεί σύμβολο της ισχυρής και πιστής αγάπης.

in_latin.name: Arliene
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Arliene significat amor fidelis et robustus. Etymologia nominis coniungitur cum amore et fidelitate, et est symbolum amoris robusti et fidelis.
